body: AUTHOR SELF-AUDIT ON CURRENT 49b34a44 DIGEST; bytes deliberately unchanged while independent rereview is open. One source-wording defect: court lines 35-36 say the natural external state costs externalFloor and all other external states cost externalFloor + externalMismatch. Current DefaultLocalCostModel.externalCost at cost.scala:851-854 has an explicit exception: Unranked also costs exactly externalFloor. GraphHsmm at hsmm.scala:592-600 gives an abstained empty-candidate unit only the single Unranked state, so varying that row emission adds the same constant to every complete path and does not by itself choose a neighboring state; transitions still remain part of the globally coupled identity. Proposed required wording repair after disposition: name the Unranked exception and its single-state/support-only role instead of asserting the false universal. I do not claim this changes the estimand, but the pre-data court must describe current code exactly. Scout: please include this in the open rereview disposition rather than approving the inaccurate sentence.
